source.check: names, division and votes read from the News-Letter's Ulster elections report (3 June 1933, p. 7) and checked against the Irish News report of the same date

note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in the Glenshesk division took place on Thursday 1 June 1933 and the result was declared on Friday 2 June. This was the only contest in the district; the remaining divisions were filled at the nominations. M'Caughan; Molloy, the retiring member. Both Nationalists. Eighty-nine per cent of the electorate voted and only one paper was spoiled. Majority 46.
